laws.rule: Drinking alcohol on the street is banned in the Community of Madrid (the botellón rule), except on bar terraces and on fair or patron-saint festival days regulated by a municipal ordinance. This is article 30.3 of Ley 5/2002 on drug dependence. Councils can declare priority zones where the ban is enforced. For an adult the fine is double the general scale, whose minor-offence band is EUR 300 to 30,050 (articles 52.5(b) and 59.1; about A$477 to A$47,700 before doubling, at EUR 0.6293 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026). For under-18s the fine is EUR 500 (about A$795), higher for repeats within six months. Councils run the penalty process.
